==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Nightfall
| complete = [[Armored Transport]]
}}

===Objectives===
* Find the [[Shipment of Ink|shipment of ink]] somewhere on the Plains of Jarin.
* Bring the box of ink back to Kailona and collect your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* 5 [[Sunspear promotion point]]s
* [[Battle Commendation]]
* [[Rune of Minor Vigor]]

==Walkthrough==
Travel to the Sunspear Great Hall and walk out to the Plains of Jarin.  Head west and then north, hugging the side of the building.  Once you've cleared the building, head north towards the shoreline.  You'll find the shipment of ink waiting for you there.  Grab it, and then return to Kamadan to see Kailona.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Kailona
:''"'''<Character name>''', I have need of your help.  My shipment of '''ink''' is late.  Three days late.  I need the ink to craft my runes, and I have customers waiting.  These shipments are normally very prompt, so such tardiness worries me.  If you could look into what has caused this delay, I would be willing to give you a useful rune in exchange for your services.  The shipments usually come in through the '''Plains of Jarin''', so that would be a good place to start looking.  Are you interested?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Sure, I could use one of those runes anyway.
|decline = No thanks, I have pressing business at the moment.
|ask = Find the shipment of '''ink''' and I'll give you a Rune of Minor Vigor.  Search the '''Plains of Jarin'''.  The shipments usually come through there. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Kailona
:''"Washed ashore, you say?  That isn't good.  Not good at all.  Looks like I'll need to find another supplier.  Well, here is the Rune of Minor Vigor I promised you.  To equip the rune, double-click it in your inventory and click on the piece of armor you want to put it into.  Once you put a rune into a piece of armor, the only way to get it out is to salvage the armor with an expert or superior salvage kit.  This will destroy the armor, but you have a chance to get your rune back.  Good luck!"''

==Notes==
* The Rune of Minor Vigor that this quest rewards may only be sold once per [[account]]. Once ''any'' of your [[character]]s have sold it to a [[rune trader]], other characters cannot sell the quest reward rune to a rune trader. However, this seems to reset if you delete the character that sold the rune originally.

{{Bug|Kailona incorrectly suggests that using expert or superior salvage kits always destroys the armor to which they are applied; there is a minimum 50% chance to retain the armor (see [[salvage]] for details).}}
